title: Bahnsen's notes on unexplained effect

tellings.quote: And Bonson writes in his notes that there's something going on here that we're unable to account for.

plain: In the 1950s in Chapel Hill, North Carolina, a man named Agnew Bahnson wrote in his private notes that "there's something going on here that we're unable to account for," about an effect he could not explain. The researcher Paul Schatzkin, who has studied the inventor Townsend Brown, brings this up from Bahnson's notes without pointing to a published source. He tells it as a sign that serious experimenters were seeing something new.
